title: Vuur: Create Factory
body:
🚂 Vuur: Create Factory
Welcome to our custom Minecraft modpack built around the updated Create mod! Designed for me and my friends, this pack lets us build our very own factory empire from the ground up. Whether you're into massive automated farms, intricate mechanical contraptions, or just want to ride a conveyor belt across the world, this is the place to do it.

With the power of the Create mod at your fingertips, you'll be crafting machines, automating production lines, and engineering like never before. This isn’t just survival—it’s industrial revolution, block by block.

Let’s build, automate, and have a blast together!
